sq.q: \(\text{Given Fourier series } f(x) = \frac{a_0}{2} + \sum (a_n \cos nx + b_n \sin nx), \text{ find total power using Parseval.}\)
answer: \(\text{Each term } \frac{1}{2}(a_n^2 + b_n^2) \text{ is power in nth harmonic}\)
